findings.claim: The pin never exercises the engine's default host-own folder resolution (attemptload.go:419-422). Every count case overrides readers.hostOwnAdmission, and the one case that clears it resolves the host folder to the selected folder. Replacing 'host, _ = resolveHostOwnAdmissionPath(hostAdmissionDirectoryForTest)' with 'host = selected' leaves the committed pin passing, while the engine's census loses the fix.
findings.evidence: Overlay mutation H in /tmp/u1r2read.dCJA9z: the pin PASSES (out-H.log). The engine-faithful probe, with hostAdmissionDirectory following the test variable, shows the finding-553 decoy counted 1 on the real and fake roots under H (out-NSH.log) and 0 on the candidate (out-NS.log). Mutations B, C, E and F each fail the pin (out-B/C/E/F2.log). resolveHostAdmissionPath, which returns the selected namespace when the test variable is set, differs by one word from resolveHostOwnAdmissionPath, and D2 hides the known reproducer.
findings.change: Optional: add one case that overrides the selected side instead of the host side, so the default resolution runs with host = hostAdmissionDirectoryForTest and the marker goes in that folder. Alternatively, put the two-line resolution in a small helper and assert it.

findings.claim: readProcessRows gates the host-own read on host != selected rather than on the test variable. When hostAdmissionDirectory() errors, selected is "", so a production engine without the test variable reads ~/.metasystem/proof-admission as the host-own folder. countProofLaunchers, through the attempt-load launcherCount, then drops host-managed launchers that base counted as unmanaged.
findings.evidence: attemptload.go:418-425; base readProcessRows/managedProofProcess at eee933013 count every launcher when hostAdmissionDirectory errors. The heavy admission loop is unaffected because AcquireHostResourcesWithWaitCheck returns early on that error. The case needs secureHostAdmissionDirectory to fail while validateHostAdmissionDirectory(folder, 0o700) passes, which is improbable.
findings.change: Optional: also clear host when selected == "", or gate on the test variable as the brief wrote.
